title: Link two nodes
explanation:
Each node holds a value and a pointer to the next node.
A null next pointer marks the end of the list.

question.prompt: Which line links a to b as its next node?
question.hint: Find the node whose next field should hold the address of b.

options.feedback: a.next stores the address of b.
This points b back to a.
A null next pointer leaves a at the end.
